confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Edinburgh price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately confident; the midrange meal assumes a typical service charge where one is added. Cocktail and wine reflect typical bar prices cross-checked against the beer ratio, assuming a standard 175 ml house-wine glass. Hostel and hotel anchors for July peak season carry the widest uncertainty, roughly 25% either way. USD figures assume about 1.34 USD per GBP from general knowledge, not a live rate. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages and was not checked against the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Edinburgh's price level, benchmarked against other UK tourist cities such as Glasgow and York and adjusted up for July peak-season tourism. No web sources were used for city prices.
